text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and posted the list in our DM.

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Drivers at the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk weren't getting their text-message bay assignments. Support fixed it on 4 Oct 2025.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). The barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. It was escalated to tier-2 support for scanner firmware testing.

I checked all six of Moss's notes, and these are the only Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in them:
- The 2025-09-14 pipeline digest and the 2026-03-23 renewal note mention the account but have no ticket numbers.
- #4409, #4412 and FR-882 in the Central notes are for Pree's dealer account and Marrow Agrisupply.
- "Quarendon Freightways" (one r) is a different company that isn't our customer.

Separately, your own 2026-04-09 renewal debrief notes mention ticket #8841, a carrier portal timeout on large CSV uploads. That note isn't Moss's, so I left it off the list.
